negative_vectors.name: wrong_master_constant
negative_vectors._note: An implementation that uses 'ed25519 seed' (MXD-02's constant) instead of 'ml-dsa seed' (MXD-PQ-01's constant) at the master step will produce values that match MXD-02's master, not MXD-PQ-01's. The resulting addresses MUST NOT validate against this spec's vectors.
negative_vectors.mutation: HMAC-SHA-512(key='ed25519 seed', data=BIP-39 seed) instead of HMAC-SHA-512(key='ml-dsa seed', data=BIP-39 seed)
negative_vectors.expected_error: addr32 mismatch — implementation has used the wrong master constant

negative_vectors.name: non_hardened_index
negative_vectors.mutation: Use a non-hardened index (top bit clear) at any level.
negative_vectors.expected_error: MXD-PQ-01 forbids non-hardened indices; implementation must reject

negative_vectors.name: missing_leading_zero_byte
negative_vectors.mutation: Compute child via HMAC-SHA-512(chain, parent_xi || ser32(i)) — i.e., omit the leading 0x00 byte that the SLIP-10-shape requires.
negative_vectors.expected_error: addr32 mismatch — implementation has skipped the SLIP-10 hardened-branch disambiguator

negative_vectors.name: ml_dsa_keygen_at_intermediate_node
negative_vectors._note: An implementation that tries to compute ML-DSA-87 keys at intermediate path nodes (rather than only at the leaf) will produce 4864-byte values where this spec expects 32-byte xi values. The HD chain breaks immediately.
negative_vectors.mutation: At m/44' (intermediate), call ML-DSA-87.KeyGen(xi32) and use the resulting priv4896 (or some derivative) as input to the next level's HMAC instead of xi32.
negative_vectors.expected_error: addr32 mismatch — implementation has run KeyGen at the wrong level

negative_vectors.name: ml_dsa_keygen_with_internally_sampled_seed
negative_vectors._note: Some FIPS 204 implementations expose a KeyGen variant that samples xi from a CSPRNG internally (matching FIPS 204's default). MXD-PQ-01 forbids this for HD-derived keys; xi MUST be supplied externally as the leaf xi32.
negative_vectors.mutation: Call ML-DSA-87.KeyGen() (no seed argument) instead of ML-DSA-87.KeyGen(leaf_xi32).
negative_vectors.expected_error: non-deterministic key generation; result not reproducible from mnemonic
